title: Database page corruption on disk or a failed file read of page

comments.text:
Description:
Hello

We are running purge script on old data but yesterday we saw crashes on some of the resources.

Here is some informations attached

We looked at `8.0.37`, 38, 39 changelog but didn't find something that could help us. 

How to repeat:
Because it's a disk corruption we do not know how to reproduce this issue.
It seems it's related to index, when I see in stacktrace `btr_cur_search_to_nth_level` https://github.com/mysql/mysql-server/blob/19feac3674e2ae254b3e7fa7e116fc64ac284d8d/storag...

Salut Monsieur Tigeot,

Thank you for your bug report.

However, let us inform you that this is a forum intended only for the bugs with fully repeatable test cases.

We have not received such a test case.

This forum operates in a manner that we try to reproduce the test case provided. If we manage to repeat it with our latest  official binaries, then we can analyse whether it is a bug or not.

Hence, we can not proceed with your report.

Can't repeat.

It was not related to the index but to specific row. We ran big count(*) on small range to identify those raws and see how much we were impacted.

RDS can change your innodb recovery if you ask them. If you want to perform a mysqldump after.
